description: Born of living stone. Reforged by the hands of Wrathion's agents. Sadly much too tiny to make a difference in the black dragons' war against the djaradin.

name: Bronze Racing Enthusiast
description: This little racing enthusiast has never missed a race and has never met a racer she didn't like.

name: Magic Nibbler
description: It's tried to cut down, but magic is just so tasty.

name: Crimson Proto-Whelp
description: This proto-whelp's distinctive coloration is highly prized by pet trainers.

name: Roseate Hopper
description: Most brightly colored frogs are incredibly poisonous. The Roseate Hoppers are different because they are only credibly poisonous.

name: Stormie
description: As an egg, this proto-drake was struck by a freak bolt of lightning. Years later, the lightning still lives inside.

name: Ghostflame
description: A dream of the memory of fire.

name: Echo of the Cave
source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r World Drop|n|cFFFFD200Weather:|r Elemental Storm (Earth)|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r The Waking Shores, Ohn'ahran Plains, The Azure Span, Thaldraszus
description: Formed by the reckless use of elemental magic, the slumbering earth awakens. It is angry.

name: Echo of the Inferno
source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r World Drop|n|cFFFFD200Weather:|r Elemental Storm (Fire)|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r The Waking Shores, Ohn'ahran Plains, The Azure Span, Thaldraszus
description: A spark can become an ember. An ember can become a raging fire. This creature was never a spark or an ember, it has only ever been a raging fire.

name: Echo of the Depths
source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r World Drop|n|cFFFFD200Weather:|r Elemental Storm (Water)|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r The Waking Shores, Ohn'ahran Plains, The Azure Span, Thaldraszus
description: What the deep claims, none can reclaim.

name: Echo of the Heights
source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r World Drop|n|cFFFFD200Weather:|r Elemental Storm (Air)|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r The Waking Shores, Ohn'ahran Plains, The Azure Span, Thaldraszus
description: In the mountain air, frost lingers upon the grass as a storm rolls in.

name: Ohuna Companion
description: Its eyes can see the flick of a mouse tail from leagues away.

name: Bakar Companion
description: Faithful and ferocious, this bakar is a hero's best friend.

name: Sophic Amalgamation
description: A small fraction of the titans' power, an even smaller fraction of their size.

name: Mister Toots
source: |cFFFFD200Quest: |rSo How Did It Go?|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rThe Waking Shores
description: His name is Mister Toots because of the melodious sounds he can make with his trunk.

name: Living Mud Mask
description: The greatest souvenir available in a dragon's spa in the clouds. Not so good at facials any more, though.

name: Lady Feathersworth
description: Though she may be fashionably late, Lady Feathersworth will always show up for a party.

name: Petal
description: When the Bushbeard clan decided they were going to have a wedding, they chose Petal to be the flower girl. She was spectacular.

name: Obsidian Proto-Whelp
description: After finding a clutch of black proto-whelps, Wrathion took them under his wing.

name: Dust Spirit
description: When it was captured and bound to a cage made of enchanted metal, this spirit managed to twist and reshape the metal into the suit of armor it now wears.

name: Blaze Spirit
description: This is the soul of a forest fire. Though its armor keeps its flames under control, you sometimes notice it gazing longingly at dead trees and dry underbrush.

name: Gale Spirit
description: When it was the wind, this spirit carried scents to every corner of Azeroth. Sometimes you can still smell on it the barest hint of food, smoke, or the carnage of battle.

name: Tide Spirit
description: I wish that I could bind the tides and bend them to my will. But in its depths the sea abides and waits for no one still.

name: Scout
description: Scout came to the Dragon Isles for adventure and excitement. After finding you, he got both.

name: Cubbly
description: Cubbly's extended proximity to time magic has given him powers far beyond the average bear.

name: Pinkie
description: With her distinctive coloration and impeccable work ethic, Pinkie has propelled herself to the top of the tallstrider fashion world.

name: Troubled Tome
description: Do you dare to open this book of draconic secrets?

name: Snowclaw Cub
source: |cFFFFD200World Event:|r Primal Bear Cub|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Azure Span
description: An adult Snowclaw can rattle the very trees with its roar. A cub can rattle one of the smaller branches.

name: Bugbiter Tortoise
source: |cFFFFD200World Event:|r A Small Favor for Cymre Brightblade|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Waking Shores|n
description: This turtle eats bugs, as you'd expect from its name, but you wouldn't believe how large the bugs are.

name: Driftling
description: This creature is usually known to be quite docile, but try to stick a carrot in its face and YOU WILL lose feeling in your fingers.

name: Flow
description: Perks its head up when hearing conversation as it likes to stay current on world affairs.

name: Tremblor
description: Claims to be from a long lost land from the remnants of a massive volcano, but that story seems a little shaky.

name: Wildfire
description: The flames surrounding it burn more intensely during combat. Could even say that pet battles get it stoked.

name: Vortex
description: Arrogant from a past life in the stormy Forbidden Reach, pines after the good old days when the elements controlled the land. Bit of a blow hard really.

name: Gilded Mechafrog
source: |cFFFFD200Treasure:|r Tattered Gift Package|n|cFFFFD200NPC:|r Prototype Tinker-Tron|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Zskera Vaults, The Forbidden Reach|n
description: An old and dangerous discarded toy.

name: Volatile Self-Driving Toolbox
description: Who needs a toolbelt when a handy robot can follow you around! Just don't bump into it too hard.

name: Roland
description:
If Roland has taught you anything, it's that friendship comes at a price.

That price is lots and lots of cheese.

name: Blaise
description: Like a campfire, but it wants skritches.

name: Ambre
description: Nothing sparked joy in Ambre's heart until it found the perfect match.

name: Azure Swoglet
description: Other frogs like to play, but this one is feeling too blue.

name: Emerald Swoglet
description: Being green is... not easy.

name: Annuna
description: Annuna's distinctive coloration is due to her eating nothing but orange dragonflies.

name: Crimson Swoglet
source: |cFFFFD200Vendor: |rCelestine of the Harvest|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rThe Waking Shores|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rOhn'ahran Plains|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rThe Azure Span|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rThaldraszus|n|cFFFFD200Cost: |r250|Hitem:207026|h|TInterface\ICONS\INV_Enchant_DustStrange.blp:0|t|h
description: Crimson swoglets are considered the most scholarly of all swoglets because they're well red.

name: Bronze Swoglet
description: Three years ago this swoglet was a fully grown adult.

name: Lettuce
description: Cave swallows were once plentiful in the early days of Undermine's construction. Now, goblin construction has left the population of these beautiful birds dangerously low.

name: Byrn
description: Its insides are a raging inferno. Its outside is happy pup.

name: Jade Skitterbug
description: Imagine the size of the birds that eat these bugs.

name: Lord Stantley
description: Lord Stantley will arrive fashionably early to any party that serves shrimp.

name: Savage Lobstrok
description: It's not really all that savage, just a little crabby.

name: Cheddar
source: |cFFFFD200Vendor: |rCelestine of the Harvest|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rThe Waking Shores|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rOhn'ahran Plains|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rThe Azure Span|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rThaldraszus|n|cFFFFD200Cost: |r250|Hitem:207026|h|TInterface\ICONS\INV_Enchant_DustStrange.blp:0|t|h
description: It got its name because its favorite food is fondue.

name: Devourer Lobstrok
description: Fortunately it mainly devours pet treats.

name: Abyssal Lurker
description: A warlock won this little guy at an infernal carnival, but it quickly outgrew its aquarium.

name: Void Lurker
description: How exactly does one swim through a void? This creature knows, but isn't telling.

name: Paulie
description: This type of beetle feeds on dragon scales. Its bright coloration warns predators against attack.

name: Rango
description: If bananas grew in caves, they would be Rango's favorite food.

name: Miloh
description: Miloh likes naps. Also snacks.

name: Rusty
description: Rusty's powerful nose could smell a needle in a haystack.

name: Amador
description: Amador has a big heart and loves to help people, especially children and elders. He also likes belly rubs.

name: Brul
description: Sure it's just a rock, but how much can it lift?

name: Jerrie
description: Jerrie was once an ordinary rock mouse. He still is, in fact.

name: Diamondshell
description: These snails are especially prized by many drogbar snail-racers for being fast and looking fantastic.

name: Bashful
description: While not as fast as some of the other snails in the Zaralek Cavern, Bashful makes up for it with sheer power.

name: Thimblerig
description: Known to hide money in its shell.

name: Tricky
description: Layers of rocky skin make Ambershells very tough to hurt.

name: Roseshell
description: Roseshells are known to be very agressive, but aren't very fast. So if you mess with one, prepare to be bitten in about five seconds.

name: Brulee
description: Somehow pretty and gross at the same time.

name: Ridged Shalewing
description: For a creature made of rocks it hovers quite effortlessly.

name: Soot-Stained Shalewing
description: These pests are known for their cantankerous attitudes and affinity for nesting in the smokestacks of Undermine, much to the locals dismay.

name: Ravenous Shalewing
description: This creature can eat twice its bodyweight at a single meal.

name: Shalewing Devourer
description: It doesn't even bother to chew its food.

name: Salverun
description: Perhaps you'd like to see how snakelike it can be!

name: Skaarn
description: Skaarn likes to coil up inside of your backpack.

name: Jade Cragviper
description: The Jade Cragviper's favorite food is broccoli. Actually, sorry. I just made that up.

name: Aquapo
description: The fury of the sea in the packge of a puddle.

name: Heartseeker Moth
source: |cFFFFD200World Event:|r Love is in the Air|n|cFFFFD200Cost: |r40 |Hitem:49927|h|TInterface\ICONS\INV_ValentinesCard01.BLP:0|t|h
description: Whereas some moths are attracted to light, this particular moth seems attracted to warm, fuzzy feelings. Some say the phrase "butterflies in your stomach" actually refers to an infestation of Heartseeker Moths.

name: Undermoth
description: Undermoths are known to be some of the most intelligent moths on Azeroth. This is not saying much.

name: Teardrop Moth
description: Contrary to their name, these moths are actually quite happy.

name: Rithro
description: While napping in shrubbery, sometimes his snaggletooth gets caught on a leaf.

name: Nelthara
description: Augmented by Adamanthia's Ebon Might, this whelpling is ready to face any challenge.

name: Senega
description: Senega is always ready for a ley crystal snack.

name: Axel
description: Axel likes to chase bees. No one knows why.

name: Kromos
description: Kromos can often be found napping in sandboxes.

name: Roggy
source: |cFFFFD200Achievement: |rSlow and Steady Wins the Race|n|cFFFFD200Category: |rDragon Isles
description: Roggy is the kind of snail that never gives up, no matter how hard things get.

name: Iggy
description: Solid and dependable, Iggy is always ready for a fierce battle or a gentle metaphor.

name: Newsy
description: Newsy delivers mail all around the Dragon Isles. She is so quick and reliable that the small holes on the letters she delivers are negligible.

name: Baa'lial
description: Also known as the Lord of Lies, Baa'lial is a master of deceit.

name: Mote of Nasz'uro
description: The light of the new legacy illuminates the path you forge.

name: Blub
description: Blub's heart has always been bigger than her tank, but once the rest of her got too big she had to find a new home. Fortunately, she can now travel with you and see all the marvels of the world!

name: Rusziona
description: Rusziona's newfound courage means she can accompany you on adventures! Nothing in all of Azeroth can stop her! Not even a duck!

name: Belastrasza
description: Bela has learned some humility since you first met her, so she likely won't boss you around too much.

name: Kabluey
description: Ten thousand years spent floating in a time stasis is quite a bit of time to work on material.

name: Zhusadormu
description: Now that he's no longer sneezing through time, Zhusa is ready to accompany you on your future adventures! Or past adventures! Or future adventures!

name: Pallibrius
description: Pallibrius is an amazing book because of its wealth of arcane knowledge. Also because of all the pie recipes its previous owner scribbled in the margins.

name: Zalethgos
description: Zaleth is looking forward to accompanying you on your adventures. He's already got a list of books he wants to take with him, but Lasztak said he could only bring 2.

name: Somnius
description: Somnius is legendary for her ability to sleep through everything except suppertime.

name: Posidriss
description: Posidriss is excited to go on adventures with you, but maybe let them have a nap first?

name: Princess Vorquistrasza
description: Princess Vorquistrasza wants you to know that she appreciates you coming to her birthday party, but is underwhelmed by your gift.

name: Spirit of Competition
description: These stunning creatures, awarded to heroes for victory in battle, represent bravery and strength.

name: Doomrubble
description: He seems to be very angry, but it's possible he's just hungry.

name: Gill'dan
description: Gill'dan earned his great power by drinking the blood of a demon, which would also have turned his scales green had they not already been that color.

name: Jeepers
description: This eye has witnessed untold horrors, and these fangs may be responsible for a few of their own.

name: Obsidian Warwhelp
description: A war-obsessed world turned her into a weapon... but they couldn't break her spirit.

name: Briarhorn Hatchling
description: Loves: Broccoli, playing, and smashing things. Hates: Meat, sleeping, and mean titan keepers who won't let you smash things.

name: Killbot 9000
description: DEFECTIVE; REFUSES TO KILL. MARK FOR IMMEDIATE DESTRUCTION OR SALE TO LESS INTELLIGENT ENTITY.

name: Slyvy
description: These astral phenomena are rarely sighted due to the speed of the slyvern. It is a good omen to have one following you around.

name: N'Ruby
description: A lifetime of servitude to Anub'arak, then the Lich King, and now... you!

name: Tobias
source: |cFFFFD200Achievement:|r Community Rumor Mill|n|cFFFFD200Event:|r Secrets of Azeroth
description: With a nose for secrets, Tobias is ready to be by the side of super sleuths.

name: Fyrn
description: Fyrn will be the first one to show up at your birthday party and the last to leaf.

name: Lil' Frostwing
description: Feel the chill nipping at your toes! A menace of Azeroth, now in festive blue and travel-size!

name: Squally
description: Though this little one's flight training has yet to be completed, their playfulness and enthusiasm are already fully grown.

name: Lil' Maggz
description: As heir to the Lord of Outland, Maggz has always shared his family's love of violence and power. He just happens to be even more in love with pet treats.

name: Sergeant Quackers
description: When enemy combatants fly overhead, there's only one thing to do. Duck.

name: Aura
description: At a young age Aura donned her magic hat, took her crystal staff, and set off for adventure into the unknown.

name: Reverie
description: The duck of your dreams... or perhaps someone else's dreams.

name: Blueloo
description: If you ever have an outdoor feast in the Emerald Dream, look out for wild blueloos. A blueloo won't steal your picinic basket, but it will politely ask for some snacks.

name: Dreamborne Scarab
description: Compared to a fully grown dreamborne scarab, this is the lesser of two weevils.

name: Dreamhoof
description: Be sure to sleep with some grass under your pillow so you can give this critter a snack while you dream.

name: Ivy
source: |cFFFFD200Achievement:|r "Don't Let the Doe Hit You On the Way Out"|n
description: Since you rescued her from Larodar, this grateful little doe hasn't stopped following you around.

name: Memorie
description: It is said that some animals dream in black and white. This animal only dreams in green.

name: Napps
description: This creature could sleep through another Cataclysm.

name: Snoozles
description: Snoozles was once given a choice between life in the timeless beautiful snowfields and life in a warm home with pet treats. We know which one he chose.

name: Kal'andu
description: Rescued from the Druids of the Flame's onslaught upon the Emerald Dream, this juvenile faerie dragon has taken a liking to you -- and to your food. Don't leave your snacks unattended!

name: Seedle
description: Seedles burrow beneath plants in the emerald dreams and nibble at their roots.

name: Dustite
description: Dustites scavenge among the roots of great trees for any small leavings they can find.

name: Somnolet
description: Dream on. Dream until your dream comes true!

name: Snoots
description: Snoots has a supernatural sense of smell. It's not any better than normal, it's just supernatural.

name: Elmer
description: Elmer once ate a whole cake all by himself. It wasn't even his cake.

name: Spruce
description: What Spruce lacks in speed, she makes up for with sheer stubbornness.

name: Juniper
description: Juniper's unique coloration makes it hard to hide from predators in the Emerald Dream's lush green foliage. She therefore made the wise decision to travel with you instead.

name: Drowsey
description: Is it a snail? Is it a dream? Is it the dream of a sleeping snail?

name: Snorr
description: Wyvern whelps are sleepy by nature. The dreams of wyvern whelps are doubly so.

name: Mitzy
description: When she grows up, Mitzy wants to guide Greatfather Winter's sleigh just like Metzen, her famous dad. Until then, she's more than happy to come with you on your adventures.

name: Lil' Wrathion
description: Tell them that I am free of my father's madness, and I will be free of them as well. I am to be left alone: this will be my first and only warning. - Wrathion

name: Arfus
description: There must always be a Lick King.

name: Teele
description: Teele's grandparents told him they were the mice that discovered Azeroth. They were also champion fibbers.

name: Sarge
description: When he's not hanging out with Harth Stonebrew or winning competitions at the tavern, Sarge loves to stow away in the backpacks of visiting adventurers.

name: Nelle
description: Though fully-grown maidenbugs are able to fly, Nelle is just a bit too young for that. She's happy to skitter alongside you all the same.

name: Buggsy
description: Farmers will often release maidenbugs to battle the pests that threaten their crops. Buggsy was so good at this that she decided to go pro.

name: Lovely Duckling
description: Of all the shades and colors of ducklings that come forth in the spring, the most prized are the pink ones. There are many theories about why, but it's likely just because pink is awesome.

name: Beetriz
description: Yellow maidenbugs are often mistaken for other yellow insects. This happens even more often to Beetriz, and she doesn't understand why.

name: Reese
description: Even Nirobin, a self-proclaimed genius of the highest caliber, could not deny the cuteness of his arcane creation.

name: Hap'he
description: It is bewildering how the most arrogant and stuck up of the Azerothian Archivists can't help but create the most adorable arcane familiars. Perhaps Nirobin does have a soft side...

name: Hoplet
description: Because it's her favorite holiday, Hoplet wears her Lunar Festival outfit year-ound.

name: Pokee
description: The needle in Pokee's eye isn't exactly comfortable fashion, but he's stuck with it.

name: Remembered Riverpaw
description: Once tenacious and terrible, the riverpaw slaughtered weaker enemies without hesitation.

name: Remembered Construct
description: Made from the bits and pieces of vanquished abominations, light magic, and just a pinch of nostalgia.

name: Remembered Spawn
description: The faded memory of an Onyxian whelpling, this young dragon has decided that it wants to follow in its own footsteps.

name: Hallowed Glowfly
description: This hallowed firefly's glow scours the darkness, a welcome omen for the Arathi living in Hallowfall.

name: Thunder
description: Someday, his heavy footfalls and ferocious roar will match his name. Until then, Thunder remains a bolt of cuteness and loyalty.

name: Illskitter
description: Graduation from spiderling to fully-fledged spider monster is far off for this young arachnoid.

name: Rak-Ush Threadling
description: Awww, aren't her pedipalps adorable?

name: Moss Skipper
description: Finally caught a blind cave skipper. He flopped helplessly for twenty minutes and then let out a burp. Great companion he is!

name: Redthroat Skipling
description: Though eye-catching, their namesake coloration is rubbish for camouflage. The blind skiplings couldn't care less.

name: Skippy
description: Watch Skippy swim, and then watch him run. The perfect amphibian. Sorry, frogs.

name: Waddles
description: Waddles was rejected by the other cave skippers and fell through the cracks, literally, all the way down to Harandar. He's known to follow around people he finds.

name: Wriggle
description: The wily fish has never been caught at the end of an angler's hook. He was caught a completely different way.

name: Nightfarm Growthling
description: These highly destructive pests are known to destroy crops in Hallowfall.

name: Blightbud
description: Please keep your blightbud on a leash at all times! They are notorious for the havoc they can wreak on unprotected gardens.

name: Sceaduthax
description: This dark-shelled monster thrives in shadows. It's where he does all his best thinking.

name: Pillarnest Bonedrinker
description: Is it possible to drink bones? Not without a positive mental attitude it's not!

name: Venomwing
description: It's not the most original anti-hero name. But it promises to be a compelling crossover.

name: Frenzied Bloodtick
description: Most people don't find congealed blood particularly appetizing. Bloodticks, though...

name: Burntram
description: Look out! He's comin' right for us! Gradually!

name: Starkstripe Hopper
description: Brightly colored means do not touch. Red is nature's warning light!

name: Muskpaw Calf
description: This little yak is far snugglier than most of it's kin. And slightly less smelly!

name: Astral Emperor's Serpentling
description: It is said that the Astral Emperor wove these creatures from the stuff of the stars themselves. It is also said that he used only the cutest star-stuff.

name: Shadowbog Hopper
description: Restoring hope to those lost in the darkness comes with its just rewards. Like cute frog friends.

name: Chester
source: |cFFFFD200Drop:|r Delve's Bountiful Coffer and Hidden Trove|n
description: Part lean, mean candle-throwing machine. Part adventurer wannabe. All kobold.

name: Waxwick
description: In a miracle of dreams and wishes, Waxwick awoke and climbed off a kobold's head to pursue her own path.

name: Tiberius
description: The Imperial Lynx hails from the shore of the far-flung Arathi Empire, where they serve as fierce and loyal companions and mounts for citizens.

name: Vanilla
description: This treasured lynx is a firm supporter of no changes.

name: Bean
description: The toes! The huge toe beans! The huge toe beans are not for eating!

name: Argos
description: The Imperial Lynx is known for being stubborn and moody, but fiercely loyal to those they form bonds with.

name: Fathom Incher
description: In the depths of the Endless Sea, strange thalassic horrors lurk. Not this fella, though. He's completely normal.

name: Loamy
description: The softest and fluffiest protosheep made of the softest and fluffiest soil.

name: Spinner
description: She'll try spinning, that's a good trick.

name: Webbers
description: Web ball! Stone of reality! Web ball! Stone of reality!

name: Itchbite
description: A bug? Wait a minute, no, it's a small friendly spider!

name: Anub'Rekyute
description: He hears little hearts melting. Faster now!

name: Fuzzy
source: |cFFFFD200Achievement:|r Family Battler of Khaz Algar|n|cFFFFD200Category:|r Battle
description: The next time you're sitting in the dark and feel something brush against your heel, don't worry! It's just Fuzzy.

name: Bouncer
description: Awww, aren't it's fuzzy little pedipalps cute?

name: Jump Jump
description: I jump, Jon. It's what I do.

name: Fringe
description: Someone once mistook Fringe for an azerite node. He's too young to remember azerite, though.

name: Sir Shady Mrrgglton Junior
description: The shadowy creature has been following Sir Finley Mrrgglton around ever since he happened upon it during one of his expeditions. Having grown quite fond of the tenebrous friend, Sir Finley won't part with it easily.

name: Sandstone Ramolith
description: They loves sand. It's coarse, and it gets everywhere.

name: Clay Stonecharger
description: The swooping horns of protorams bear the scars of every charge.

name: Slim
description: One kobyss's meal is another adventurer's bestie.

name: Marrlok
description: Ancient Gorian blood runs through Marrlok's veins. As far as anyone knows, his desire to rest for long stretches of time on a sunny beach keeps his imperial ambitions in check.

name: Bop
description: Woah there pardner. Were you really about to buzz by without saying howdy?

name: Trishi
description: She sees you when you're sleeping.

name: Worgli the Apprehensive
description: Maybe give up! Maybe surrender!

name: Writhing Transmutagen
description: The early worms get the bird.

name: Whoopy
description: Delivers the goods while also looking good.

name: Lil' Manny
description: As master of all the ball pit lords, Manny rules over playgrounds with a spirit filled with fun and mischievousness.

name: Guacamole
description: This snuffling loves limes.

name: Sneef
description: She's got a schnoz for sniffin'!

name: Cinderwold Sizzlestinger
source: |cFFFFD200Quest:|r Home Is Where the Candle Is|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rThe Ringing Deeps
description: Now that is one spicy bee!

name: Cinderhoney Emberstinger
description: THE BEES ARE ON FIRE NOW?

name: Ruby-Eyed Stagshell
description: Stagshells crave violence. Or at least simulated representations of violence.

name: Rak-Ush Battleshell
description: Raised as living tanks for Anub'azal's army, Rak-Ush's battleshells are surprisingly affectionate. Who's a good beetle?

name: Brown Leafbug
description: When you tell a bad joke, he'll be there to let you know.

name: Flash
description: Emberrooks are the rarest and most aggressive of the rook elementals.

name: Thundo
description: A full-sized stormrook's thunder can be heard for miles. The chirps of this small spark sound like a faulty electrical device.

name: Gale
description: A Stormrider's stormrook can not only navigate extreme winds with grace but can also conjure fierce tempests to defend themselves.

name: Misty
description: There are many creatures lurking in the Cape of Stranglethorn who would be glad to kill you. Misty is just curious to see the rest of the world.

name: Craggles
description: This boarlet escaped Coldridge Valley in search of adventure and maybe a nice apple if she can find one.

name: Oop'lajax
description: He's a little jumpy... especially around the face.

name: Lil' Moss Rosy
description: Counting sheep to a dream of springtime.

name: Dalaran Sewer Turtle
description: More than a typical turtle, he's a hero in a half shell!

name: Lil' Flameo
description: Lil' Flameo is ready to drop foolish pets if they get in the way.

name: Sapphire Crab
description: These crabs build their own shells from small fragments of rocks and gems.

name: Coppers
description: One hero's trash is another kobold's treasure. This unfortunately does not work in reverse.

name: Wobbles
description: Incredibly lifelike, this enchanted wax statue could pass for a real mole. If petting it didn't cause it to melt, that is.

name: Faithful Dog
description: No longer lost or lonely, your faithful companion has decided that by your side is the best place to be.

name: Violet Sporbit
description: Dangerous, toxic spores? What if it was purple?!

name: Mind Slurp
description: One shudders to imagine whether the name was based off of what it is... or what it does.

name: Lil' Bonechewer
description: Lil' Bonechewer loves you, even if you were a worm. Especially if you were a worm.

name: Rak-Ush Battleshell
description: Raised as living tanks for Anub'azal's army, Rak-Ush's battleshells are surprisingly affectionate. Who's a good beetle?

name: Claudius
description: Claudius is known for being brutally honest as well as a great singer. He knows your jewels would look better on him.

name: Vibrant Glowfly
source: |cFFFFD200Pet Battle: |rAzj-Kahet, City of Threads, Hallowfall, Shadowvein Extraction Site, The Ringing Deeps
description: Though their light is sometimes mistaken for the glow of toxic substances or dark magic, nerubians and Arathi alike find these insects hauntingly beautiful.

name: Pinkskin Burrower
description: So wrinkly!! So scrunchy!!

name: Troglofrog
source: |cFFFFD200Pet Battle: |rAzj-Kahet, City of Threads, Deepforge Golemworks, Hallowfall, Isle of Dorn, The Ringing Deeps
description: The sound of the troglofrog echoing throughout deep caverns sounds almost like... ragtime music?

name: Gizmo the Pure
description: In life, Gizmo never hurt a soul. Having been brutally murdered, he now considers violence.

name: Parrlok
description: Ancient Gorian blood runs through Parrlok's veins. As far as anyone knows, his desire for enjoying pastries and chatting with his friends keeps his imperial ambitions in check.

name: Gummi
description: Gummi baubleworms have an abundance of natural predators, as they are known for their rubbery texture and sweet flavors.

name: Thrillbot 9000
description:
PRIMARY DIRECTIVE: ENGAGE IN HEROICS.
PREFERRED HEROICS: THRILLING.
SECONDARY DIRECTIVE: BECOME HERO.
PREFERRED HERO: BIG.

name: Chillbot 9000
description:
RELAXATION MODE: ENGAGED.
RELAXATION LEVEL: MAXIMUM.
INTERNAL TEMPERATURE: LOW.

name: Brrrgl
description: A master of distractions, Brrrgl can steal your heart with a dance, a fish or some friends.

name: Gill'el
description: Gill'el stepped down from leading Frostfin clan to commune with the elements. His return has sparked excitement in all.

name: Bluedoo
description: Bluedoo's magic and skills in accupuncture will help any in need of relaxation.

name: Reven
description: The game's afoot. Except when it is time to nap. Afterwards though, it's game on!

name: Timbered Sky Snakelet
description: It is almost as if a wooden toy has come to life. Keep this pet away from children.

name: Specter
description: Found by Taunka as a newborn pup Specter is fiercely loyal. Yet he is beginning to live up to his name as he stalks into the world.

name: Karazhan Syphoner
description: Rarely captured alive, syphoners are some of the most dangerous of the mana wyrms. This one happened to have been distracted while binging on a particularly juicy spell book in the Karazhan library.

name: Razeshi B.
description: Razeshi B. is known for her short temper, quick wit and sharp barbs. The B. stands for "Best check yourself."

name: Grunch
source: |cFFFFD200Quest:|r You're A Mean One...|n|cFFFFD200World Event:|r Winter Veil|n
description: It's best not to ask how Grunch acquired all these gifts because you know it's not because he's been nice.

name: Portentous Present
description: Previous owners of the crate have reported the disappearance of other pets from their collection.

name: Tiny Torq
description: Tiny Torq's dad could TOTALLY beat up Flarendo's dad.

name: Iron Chick
description: Shrugs off boiling oil and eleven secret herbs and spices. Just don't introduce it to rust.

name: Viridian Mechasaur
description: It totally fell into a pit of acid but then it came back ten times stronger! So cool!!!

name: Wavebreaker Mechasaur
description: And then, woosh! It comes stampeding out of the ocean and like, roars! Raaargh!

name: Mechagopher
description: Do you see pity in these blinking, soulless eyes? I didn't think so.

name: Professor Punch
description: And he was all like, Primal Punch!!

name: Crimson Mechasaur
description: It's red because it like, killed so many bad guys! It's all their blood! And it's on fire too!

name: Mega-Mecha Gorilla
description: Mega-Mecha Gorilla possesses the strength of not one, but FIVE gorillas.

name: Fun-Size Flarendo
description: Nuh-uh! Yellow is coolest! It's themed after the original, who's totally gonna beat that stupid gorilla!

name: Bilgewater Junkhauler
description: Scrap metal hunks hauling junk.

name: Steamwheedle Flunkie
description: It's lame to have a hunchbacked crony mewl 'yes master' when you can just get a robot to do it for free.

name: Personal-Use Sapper
description: Fun for the whole family! A self-detonating robot for all occasions!

name: Mr. DELVER
description: Originally built by Dr. DELVER to compete with renowned treasure hunter Brann Bronzebeard. Never really panned out though, so now he just helps out.

name: Venture Companyman
description: Yes boss! Yes boss! Yes boss!

name: Blackwater Kegmover
description: Being a pirate is alright with me, especially if you've got this thing willing to carry your grog.

name: Rocketfist
description: And even if they reach the danish, they'll never get past Rocketfist!

name: Mutt
description: One more thing... Show my hound some respect.

name: Eepy
description: He's just a bit tuckered out. He's just a little guy.

name: Grinner
description: Look, she likes it! She's smiling, see!

name: Foreman
description: Eagerly attends every cookout. He just wants to grill for gob's sake!

name: Scruff
description: Gotta be tough with the scruff.

name: Goggles
description: Do the hyenas need to wear goggles? Absolutely not. Does it look extremely cool? Incredibly.

name: Cruncher
description: The itchy legs! The wiggly antennae! Okay, fine, he's not cute. But he's trying!

name: Lab Rat
description: They weren't lying, this rat can absolutely get that dang cheese.

name: Spotty
description: People get turned into rats sometimes. It's not that weird.

name: Living Rose
source: |cFFFFD200World Event:|r Love is in the Air|n|cFFFFD200Cost: |r40 |Hitem:49927|h|TInterface\ICONS\INV_ValentinesCard01.BLP:0|t|h
description: When being adored, a Living Rose emits beautifully intoxicating aromas. When ignored, those aromas become actually toxic.

name: Marmaduke
description: Though left behind on the Siren Isle, this old but very good boy proves that some things only get better with age.

name: Rock Hound Mica
description: This good girl loves nothing more than the feeling of the warm sun on her coat and freshly dug earth between her paws.

name: Wanderer Liu
description: Like most young meeksi, Liu has a penchant for finding both trouble and adventure. Unlike other meeksi, Liu can teleport across great distances in search of both.

name: Sparklesnap
description: Reaching for what you thought was a pile of plunder turned out to be Sparklesnap's treasure-laden shell. After mistakenly petting his back, he now eagerly follows you.

name: Glamrok
description: Glamrok followed you back to the ship one day after a particularly good plunder, sensing your keen knack for treasure-finding.

name: Bubbles
description: Where do all of the bubbles come from? What are they made of? Perhaps some mysteries are best left unexplored.

name: Happy
description: It doesn't seem to know where it is, but it's happy to be here!

name: Wind-Up Wuffi
description: With a face this lovable Wuffi is sure you'll wind-up being the best of friends.

name: Wind-Up Woofer
description: A wag of their tail always brings a smile to your face, like clockwork.

name: Crackleroar
description: This small cub has been influenced by constant storms on Siren Isle. Just petting it's soft fur sends static shocks across your hand.

name: Skitterbite
description: This krolusk seems to display an unusual level of intellegence in it's shiny red, reflective eyes.

name: Teatuft Tamer
description: The meeksi Teatuft Tamers love lounging with their Teatufts and sipping a cup of mystical tea after a long lazy day.

name: Fullbelly Rollingpaw
description: The Fullbelly meeksi will often put their own safety at risk if they smell food. Nothing brings them happiness like a cup of tea and a warm meal.

name: Mech-Friend Maya
description: Meet your new best mech-friend, Maya. Maya loves a good, tight wind-up so she can spring into action.

name: Merriment
description: This thing is equally as evil as it is adorable.

name: Void-Scarred Parrot
source: |cFFFFD200Treasure:|r Wyrmbane's Corrupted Chest|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Vision of Stormwind (Revisited)
description: Stormwind's Trade District sees many goods and animals pass through its auction house. Once the parrots of Stranglethorn were an expensive luxury. Now those present when N'zoth took over are a scourge.

name: Eye of Chaos
source: |cFFFFD200Treasure:|r Valeera's Corrupted Chest|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Vision of Stormwind (Revisited)
description: For so many years Mathias Shaw had his eyes and ears gathering intelligence around Azeroth. Now at least some eyes have come home.

name: Void-Scarred Scorpid
source: |cFFFFD200Treasure:|r Garona's Corrupted Chest|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Vision of Orgrimmar (Revisited)|n
description: A creature prized by rogues for its venom. Many lived in the many holes and warrens of the Drag, but after the fall these new horrors emerged to menace the survivors.

name: Void-Scarred Tallstrider Chick
source: |cFFFFD200Treasure:|r Geya'rah's Corrupted Chest|n|cFFFFD200Zone:|r Vision of Orgrimmar (Revisited)|n
description: Rarely raised in captivity, Tallstrider's are extremely territorial. A small clutch of eggs was found during a hunt, and a tauren trainer came to Orgrimmar to show them off. However, after the fall, they have become deadly once more. So far, no one has been able to direct their corrupted forms.

name: Scourge of the Aspects
description: The Scourge of the Aspects is consumed by rage and filled with a hunger to consume. Its presense is a sign of an unpredictable and erratic future for any form of dragonkin.

name: Parley
description: Parley is a rather serious and grumpy bird. If you value your eyeballs, it's best not to ask if Parley wants a cracker.

name: Parley
description: Parley is a rather serious and grumpy bird. If you value your eyeballs, it's best not to ask if Parley wants a cracker.

name: Frumpy Softpaw
description: These grumpy, frumpy meeksi only seem to find joy when drinking a boba milk tea with salted caramel and cookie dough.

name: Craboom
description: Small, snappy, and with a temper as explosive as its name. Handle with caution!

name: Tock the Clocker Spaniel
description: Tock the Clocker Spaniel is one of the best watch dogs you can ask for.

name: Devouring Runt
description: Hungry? Try eating your foes!

name: Thrrrdgl
description: Thrrrdgl is content with not being a top choice or even a second choice.  Thrrrdgl believes that first and second are the worst and third is the best.

name: Weechi
description: Weechi adores attention and what better way to get attention than wearing a costume? Simply seek out a Pet Grooming Station, near any Trading Post, to customize this sweet, wonderous little buddy.

name: Mister Mans
description: Given his boisterous behavior, we can only assume that he became imbued with the void from starting a fight. The question remains; who won?

name: Spicy Mean-Ball
description: Now this is one, spicy, mean, ball.

name: Sa'bak's Blessed
description: According to Tol'vir beliefs, a crocolisk nest that hatches during the Festival of the Sun is said to be blessed by the river guardian, Sa'bak.

name: Voidcrawler
description: Formented in the chaos and dust of Voidstorm. It hasn't even learned how to hate yet!

name: Tidbit
description: Most felstalkers are fiercesome and ravenous. This one, however, seems to be feeling a bit lonely.

name: Morsel
description: Known to take a bite out of his owner. Pet cautiously.

name: Niblet
description: Glows green, occassionally.

name: Swiftpaw
description: Cub of Blazeclaw and valiant courier of Flame's Radiance. Swiftpaw serves the Sacred Flame more ferociously than some Arathi do.

name: Helpful Workshop Bot
description: The name 'Beepbop' followed by the words 'Made by Threadis' are roughly but lovingly scratched into the bottom plate on this tiny nerubian-crafted bot.

name: Hopeflutter
description: Wherever it goes, it leaves behind a soft glow that stirs hope in even the darkest places

name: Doomfeathers
description: It glides through the air with shadowy wings and a trail of eerie whispers.

name: Ixthal the Observling
description: Ixthal enjoys hide-and-seek when not contemplating the slow devouring of entire worlds by the Void.

name: Hawkstrider Hatchling
description: When does a hatchling become a fledgling if hawkstriders never fledge?

name: Veridian Thorntail
description: This baby thorntail's favorite activity is splashing in small puddles.

name: Scrappy Thorntail
description: This little thorntail just loves to get into scraps and scrapes with its greatest foe: lapbugs.

name: Dread Horrorling
description: Early attempts to integrate with the ecosystem resulted in multiple specimens being eyeblasted.

name: Impartial Watcher
description: This watcher's ennui is as eternal as the struggle between the Light and the Void.

name: Penumbral Terror
description: It waits and watches from the shadows. Softly. Softly.

name: Rhay'Dahr
description: Ever watchful, never blinking.

name: Looker Gaz'kreth Jr.
description: While not viewed as insightful enough to be a Watcher just yet, he's on the lookout for others to share his vision with.

name: Xanthous Siphonmite
description: Siphonmites generally feed on the energies of dying worlds, but this one is perfectly content with getting some scritches from researchers instead.

name: Jimmy
description: Jimmy's actual name is Morgilito, Spawn of Morgil, Chosen Enemy of Tazavesh, Devourer of K'aresh...but everyone just calls him Jimmy.

name: Cyan Siphonmite
description: How this siphonmite snuck its way into a stasis container is anyone's guess.

name: Vitriolic Inchshifter
description: Who knew these things could eat so much?

name: Palek'ti, the Mouth of Nothingness
description: Still not quite old enough to leave the nest.

name: Shimmering Inchshifter
description: Projections showed a less than one percent chance of successful integration, but this one is too cute to eliminate.

name: Graceful Cosmic Ray Pup
description: Efforts to rewire the more desctructive tendencies of the species left this specimen more docile than most, but it was still not a successful endeavor.

name: Inquisitive Cosmic Ray Pup
description: This cosmic ray pup is curious about a great many things. Don't let it get into trouble (again)!

name: Duskthief
description: Drawn to shiny objects. And darkness. Especially darkness.

name: Starlight
description: Seeks out the light of the stars. Even in the daytime.

name: Sao'rhon
description: A very friendly cosmic being. Direct eye contact will obliterate your soul.

name: Mr. Long-Legs
description: A favorite pet of some poor soul from before the fall of K'aresh, found trapped in stasis.

name: Heka'Tarnos, Bringer of Discord
description: This exceptionally loud lapbug's calls were enough to throw the already destabilized elements in the local area into complete disarray. Now it's your turn to get bugged.

name: Copper Lapbug
description: Lapbugs were widely prized as domesticated pets before the fall of K'aresh. Copper lapbugs were especially sought-after.

name: Cerulean Lapbug
description: Widely prized as pets, cerulean lapbugs were thought to bring good fortune.

name: Flotsam Harvester
source: |cFFFFD200Vendor: |rChurbro|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rZuldazar|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rBoralus Harbor|n|cFFFFD200World Event:|r Battle for Azeroth Timewalking
description: These tiny harvesters are often deployed along the coastline during low tide to collect cargo and timbers that have washed ashore from shipwrecks.

name: Tiny Snow Buddy
description: So much holiday spirit inside an itty-bitty amount of snow, it only makes sense to share it with the world!

name: Lil' Daz'ti
source: |cFFFFD200Vendor: |rChurbro|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rZuldazar|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rBoralus Harbor|n|cFFFFD200World Event:|r Battle for Azeroth Timewalking|n
description: Ancient dinomancers once believed that pure white scales on dinosaurs indicated the influence of celestial bodies.  In their pursuit of balance, the Lun'alai have embraced these superstitions in their efforts to restore the white brutosaur.

name: Dali
description: Dali, bored of his days basking in the comfort of the Solaarian Sunbath, seeks a world of new inspiration. You are that inspiration, and he will bring color to your world.

name: Rustyroot Fel Snooter
description: Fel Snooters have a very good sense of smell. They will often immolate piles of leaves, scrap or snow to find grass and seeds.

name: Duskytooth Fel Snooter
description: The dark, fel-infused fur of the duskytooth allows them to more easily hide in the forests of Felwood.

name: Mustyfur Fel Snooter
description: An especially aggressive snooter. Its unpleasant disposition makes it an outcast among other snooters.

name: Scruffyhorn Fel Snooter
description: Of all snooters, this one has the scruffiest and warmest fur. It is a very friendly snooter but use extreme caution when petting it.

name: Shadefur Brewthief
description: If you have milk tea, keep an eye on it. Brewthieves love to pop out of the shadows and steal tea. Even worse, once in paw they love to show off their newly acquired beverage.

name: Emerald Sporbit
description: This collection of spores exploded one too many times on its previous owner. Maybe you'll have better luck with it.

name: Zo'ya
description: Zo'ya is cunning and beautiful, both highly desirable traits among purrkins. Despite being the culprit behind many mishaps, her warm glow ensures she is forgiven for any transgression.

name: Unfazed Diver
description: While purrkin have a knack for getting lost, none have ever been so talented as this one. Purrfectly unbothered however, this curious creature can thrive in any situation.

name: Smoldering Valor
description: With boundless energy and unbridled enthusiasm, the foal seeks the skies. It may not be ready, but exercise caution if you try to hold it back.

name: Anima Wyrmling
description: Even the smallest creatures in the Shadowlands rely on anima to survive.

name: Blinky
description: Blinky just hatched, and is ready for adventure, but may need a few naps along the way.

name: Akil Fledgling
description: The molted feathers of these young eagles are used to build comfortable bedding for the Amani.

name: Rootling Nester
description: Young grovecrawlers are known to curl up around the ankles of its protectors for rest.

name: Mud Potadpole
description: They do NOT taste like potatoes. Promise.

name: Violet Chick
description: These prissy, flightless birds are known to relentlessly groom themselves. Much like their riders.

name: Ebon Snapling
description: Oh snap!! Lizard!

name: Swamp Biter
description: Lurking beneath dark waters with needle sharp teeth. You can bite and drink their blood too, though. It's allowed.

name: Azure Sporebat
description: Distinct from the sporebats that reside on Draenor and Outland. It's just a coincidence.

name: Dragonhawk Mosswing
description: These dragonhawks developed in the wilds of Zul'aman, where their green feathers and molt help them hide from hunters and predators.

name: Pangolil
description: He's scheming. Smirking. Don't trust him.

name: Gloom Toad
description: Have a hoppy day!

name: Silkcrawler
description: Totally gonna transform into a beautiful winged creature, yup. It just might take a few dozen years.

name: Blistercreepling
description: You'd think with all those spikes, it might pop its own pustule sac. But no! Its pustule sac is actually really sturdy! Pustule sac!

name: Naloki
description: With war paint on her fur and a growl in her belly, Naloki dreams of one day roaring like Nalorakk.

name: Vibrant Manaling
description: The mana wyrm population really picked up after the Arcane Torrent nerf.

name: Nether Familiar
description: Arcane-infused wyrms are favored familiars of Eversong mages.

name: Wrathful Wyrm
description: It's popping wings! Run!

name: Striped Snakebiter
description: These creatures were bred to hunt snakes. With a low profile and a long body, Snakebiters are perfect for chasing serpents into their own holes.

name: Riftblade Familiar
description: Rumored to be the familiar of a ren'dorei mage that escaped to the wilds of Voidstorm and became even more void infused.

name: Emerrrgl
description: The emerald sheen of this murloc is likely formed from constant grooming and a robust exercise routine.

name: Lil' Chompers
description: If you have a fish odds are Lil' Chompers will be nearby.

name: Slippery Saul
description: Slippery Saul loves to slide around the ground or the sea looking for fish.

name: Fishmonger May
description: You can never have too many fish according to May.

name: Fishstick Keith
description: Frozen fish are Keith's favorite treat. If you've got frozen fish, you've got a new best friend.

name: Festive Eve
description: Winter festivities seem to follow Eve wherever she goes.

name: Bundled-Up Bob
description: Once native to the northern regions of the Eastern Kingdoms, this species of seal is now only common in Northrend after being hunted for food and leather during the Second War.

name: Fledgling Warden's Companion
description: This young fledgeling is ready and eager to begin training.

name: Heartglow Listener
description: Kindness gives hope golden wings, and the Heartglow Listener's feathers are with us through every tranquil night.

name: Auspicious Pixiu
description: A rare auspicious beast in Pandaria. Well-traveled hozen call it a "mobile luck amplifier."

name: Starshard Whelpling
description: Curious and inquisitive, this starry-eyed whelpling has big dreams and a wish to explore every world in the cosmos.

name: P.O.S.T. Assistant
description: While the markets of Tazavesh are a well-oiled machine, the P.O.S.T. service is a whirlwind of parchment, cartons, and rambunctious livestock. The use of P.O.S.T. assistants to handle dangerous material has saved a great many headaches.

name: Scruffbeak
description: Hatched from a long-forgotten egg, this scruffy little eagle has decided you're its new flock, whether you're ready or not.

name: Lil' Coalee
description: No one knows how Lil' Coalee got his name. Was it his black heart? Was it his love for a warm fire? Was it simply that one of his parents were Big Coalee. Asking him yields no answers, only rage.

name: Lil' Ashlee
description: Lil' Ashlee quietly bides her time waiting for a power vacuum. Once in power Lil' Ashlee will bring fun, merriment and fire to all!

name: Emerald Hatchling
source: |cFFFFD200World Quest: |rThe Battle of the Bridge|n|cFFFFD200Zone: |rSilvermoon City
description: After getting lost in the thick of battle, this hawkstrider chick needs a new home.

name: Do, Child of Filo
description: Like his father, Do speaks little but is a friend to almost everyone except those who harm innocents.

name: Dottie
description: Don't be fooled by Dottie's soft coat and big eyes, her tiny, sharp teeth are for more than just munching on grass.

name: Gillvanas
description: Little is known about the true intentions of this murloc, but her followers are among the most devoted.

name: Finduin
description: An unlikely leader of murlocs that had to step into the role after the death of his father, Murgian.

name: Moon-Touched Netherwhelp
description: A strange whelp hatched on Netherwing Ledge, it is thought to be blessed by the waning lunar energies of Shadowmoon Valley.

name: Drakks
description: A drakonid hatchling is a curious sight, but now is the time for curious things.

name: Gnomelia Gearheart
description: Spunky, funky, and just a little clunky -- she's a Gnomish engineer to a T!

name: Ysergle
description: Also known as the Dreamurk, Ysergle slumbered for many long years in the Emrgrled Dream.

name: Fathom
description: Weighed down by all the loot he has plundered. He could share the burden he carries but it turns out he's a little shellfish.

name: Silvermoon Broom
description: Magisters love to turn on their enchanted brooms before heading off to work, only to find it stuck in a corner of their Silvermoon apartment.

name: Moon Darter
description: Since Amirdrassil's emergence, many faerie dragons have taken refuge in Belameth. But many others continue to call Kalimdor home.

name: Chillcrawler
description: Chill out. It's just a spider.

name: Percival
description: This potadpole is constantly getting stuck in things.

name: Dragonhawk Munchkin
description: This tiny breed of dragonhawk is popular for those who prefer to keep their companions travel sized. Just keep them away from curtains.

name: Munchy
description: A young grovecrawler that has been lovingly cared for by the Hara'ti.

name: Lil' Preyseeker
description: This wyrm can't wait to grow up big and strong so it can hunt Prey too!

name: Distorted Memory
description: A roiling memory drawn to you from the Rift of Aln.

name: Star the Lucky Dragon
description: Star just hatched and is ready for adventure. Sometimes napping is the greatest adventure of all.

name: Gummi the Glow Wyrm
description: Gummi the Glow Wyrm has an abundance of natural predators, as it is known for their rubbery texture and sweet flavors.

name: Linda the Lucky
description: This potadpole is grateful for your assistance after having been exposed to the Lightboom.

name: Assistant Botanist Leafy
description: Assistant Botanist Leafy is an expert at identifying edible plants... which is all of them.

name: Perturbed Sporebat
description: After being rudely stuffed into a gourd in a vain effort to treat a Lightbloom infestation, this sporebat's just grateful to be out.

name: Shadowflame Remnant
description: A lingering remnant of Fyrakk's attempt at corrupting Amirdrassil.

name: Fidoficus
description: While it didn't make a good test subject, perhaps it will make a good companion.

name: Bubbly Snapling
description: What a happy snapling!

name: Spormilian
description: Waddles around in a constant cloud of spores. Harmless? Hard to say--we're still waiting on the research team... or what's left of them.

name: Treja'saka
description: A curious species found only within treasure chests. Harmless enough, unless you happen to be wearing jewelry.

name: Sporbie
description: "In this house we don't lay spores in people's ears when they sleep, no matter how funny their face is when they wake up."

name: Ominous Domanus
description: Truly evil, undeniably powerful... but above all, spectacularly lazy.

name: Nibblesworth
description: Very unhappy. Always goes for the jugular. Kind of cute.

name: Kreepah'zoyd
description: It doesn't bite. It rips and tears.

name: Ziorg'pharon
description: Ziorg'pharon, Emissary of the Cosmic Unknown, Ender of All That Is, Was, and Will Ever Be, or Zigy, as his friends call him, is physically incapable of harming a fly.

name: Hexed Bunny
description: In the wrong place at the wrong time.

name: Lost Star
description: Nothing is known for certain, though some believe it calls the night sky its home.

name: Grumpy Mandrake
description: Warning: It may root against you.

name: Sleepy Mandrake
description: Nestled in his cozy cave, this little mandrake sprout was one of the last. Over time though his favorite mushrooms stopped growing in his cave. So he decided to sleep... waiting for his favorite spores to blow in again.

name: Gortham
description: A living anomaly and Kasreth's most treasured experiment, this pink-furred creature scampers joyfully through conduits and pipes.

name: Lil' Staropod
description: Stars walk among us in the shape of a baby brutosaur.

name: Roofus
description: Roofus is ready to lend a paw for any construction project. Treats aren't required, but are appreciated.

name: Luma
description: Luma knows all kinds of tricks such as "sit," "stay," and "steal."

name: Blitzcreek
description: Evolving in the Voidstorm has really made its smaller inhabitants significantly more aggressive.

name: Willie
description: This bold elfhound was born to chase mana wyrms, and mana wyrm-shaped objects... Like unattended sausages.

name: Razeshi C.
description: Razeshi C. is known for her understanding tempermant, measured responses and a love for gossip. The C. stands for "Class act."

name: Voldy
description: Sometimes the void's call is faint, so smaller, younger voidwalkers heed its call.

name: Emberwing Hatchling
description: Born near the funeral pyre in Solemn Valley, this young eagle's burgundy feathers still carry the scent of smoke and ash. A quiet reminder that even in loss, something new can take wing.

name: Nova
description: He is a lover, not a battler.

name: Flicker
description: A rare black-furred Eversong lynx kitten, its fur faintly thrumming with arcane energy, bred by Silvermoon's Magisters as both companion and conduit of magical study.

name: Kai
description: Formed by the latent energies from the Singularity Anchor this Behemoth will be loyal till the end.

name: Medusa
description: She hates head pats, hence the spiky armor.

name: Princess Bloodshed
description: Taking after her mother, Dame Bloodshed, the Princess is armed with the sharpest of claws and the furriest of ears.

name: Nether Siphoner
description: A gnashing maw of teeth and tongues. This beast bears an uncanny resemblance to Azerothian leeches.

name: Sunwing Hatchling
description: Born and raised in Sunwing Rookery, this fella loves causing mischief when the tamers aren't looking.

name: Akiki
description: This eagle was a favored companion of Kinduru's during his travels through Zul'Aman.

name: Zan
description: This young snake was hatched from a purified egg of Ula'tek. His sister, Zarra, befriended a lonely beast stranded on Atal'Utek. However, he bonded to you and will be your fierce friend forever.

name: Sootpaw
description: This magical scout can often be found rummaging for arcane treats  in the refuse of long-past adventurers.

name: Void-Scarred Eaglet
description: The eagles of Zul'Aman are a regal species yet they have suffered without Akil'zon watching over them. Faithbreaker Ger'lok has been especially cruel testing his dark magic on the young eaglets.

name: Chubs
description: Separated from his mother when they were captured. Chubs is sad but fierce. He takes pride when he can bite his Twilight Blade handlers hands at feeding time.

name: Overloaded Manaling
description: The naga's mix of arcane and void magics have disturbed the mana wyrms around Daggerspine Point making them extremely hostile. The very few manalings remaining in the aftermath of their ritual are showing unique abilities.

name: Void-Corrupted Snapdragon
description: The loyal snapdragon are the perfect companion to any naga. They adapt well to their environment especially when the environment likes to adapt them.

name: Void-Touched Chick
description: Ravaged by the invading naga, many hawkstriders died in the area of Daggerspine Point. It is rare to find any of their young yet alive.

name: Void-Touched Lynx Kitten
description: This curious kitten has been hanging around one too many ritual sites.

name: Lil'Kruul
description: When you weren't looking, Murkidan killed Lil'Kruul. He's back now, though.

name: Furiostraza
description: She's perfect! Unlike the genetic absurdities you call twilight whelpings!

name: Poisoned Parasite
description: They suck. That's it.

name: Autumn Snapling
description: Adapted to survive in the autumnal hues of Zul'Aman foliage.

name: Cursed Spawn
description: The Curse of Ula'tek manifests serpents of all varieties. Including ones that are tiny and vaguely cute!

name: Steady Croakfrog
description: Really, really good at staring contests.

name: Sleek Snakebiter
description: The snakebiters of Atal'Utek have had their hands full as of late. They're bigs fans of your recent arrival.

name: Nightfur Kapara
description: It's said that the capybara has no enemies, but the Children of Ula'tek didn't get that memo.

name: Jaundiced Slitherer
description: These snakes dredge themselves out of the venom to live miserable existences. Also, do you mind if they crash at your place for a weekend?

name: Caustic Writhling
description: There's Children of Ula'tek, and then there's the BABY of Ula'tek!

name: Rescued Dragonhawk Chick
description: The exposure to void energy was minimal, however it is already showing signs of new void abilities. Its abilities can be managed with the right training. - Sergeant Vornin

name: Void-Infused Mindbreaker Fry
description: The mindbreakers are a rare creature of the deep. Little is known of their true origins but they link back to the days of the Black Empire.

name: Wriggling Capybara
description: At home in small dens, these little guys wriggle into all sorts of tight spots, even sometimes supply pouches.

name: Cappy
description: Having the bad luck to face many void corruption hostilities, Cappy has persevered. He is one of the few creatures to make it through mostly unscathed.

name: Curious Lynx Kitten
description: The saying curiosity killed the cat wasn't written about the Eversong lynx, even if their reckless kittens do find their way to the frontlines. A few rangers have found a lifelong companion stowed away in the supply wagons on campaign.

name: Emberlyn
description: Kindled in a ritual of flame and feather, she grows with a restless heat, drawn to the softest morsels and the sharpest scents, her tiny wings carrying both comfort and cinders wherever she flits.

name: The Sire's Ghastly Screecher
description: A rare mutation gives this dredbat its green, ghastly glow making it a sought after gift for pet collectors with eclectic tastes.

name: Sunflicker Driftmoth
description: Lazy as a mote of dust in a sunbeam, this moth drifts with the breeze as if in no particular hurry to be anywhere.

name: Sha-Warped Hippogryph Hatchling
description: Sha has warped this hippogryph hatchling into an adorable but fearsome creature. The big emotions that flow through this creature make it an adorable harbinger of doom.

name: Ka'bubb
description: A true Abyss Angler, certified by Depthdiver Jeju himself.

name: Unborn Val'kyr
description: Val'kyr are considered "unborn" until they vanquish a creature of high nobility.

name: Nexus Whelpling
description: The runts of Malygos brood, these whelplings are prized for their boundless arcane magics.

name: Chitterspine Skitterling
description: The chitterspine make a distinctive clicking noise when they see prey in the open.

name: Emerald Proto-Whelp
description: These beautiful drakes can be found across the shores of Northrend.

name: Infected Squirrel
source: |cFFFFD200Pet Battle: |rBloodmyst Isle, Eastern Plaguelands, Silverpine Forest
description: More horrifying than its appearance is that the infected squirrels of the Plaguelands no longer hoard nuts, instead collecting rotten, decaying flesh.

name: Rabbit
source: |cFFFFD200Pet Battle: |rAzshara, Blade's Edge Mountains, Crystalsong Forest, Darkshore, Dun Morogh, Duskwood, Elwynn Forest, Eversong Woods (Burning Crusade), Feralas, Highmountain, Hillsbrad Foothills, Howling Fjord, Moonglade, Mount Hyjal, Mulgore, Nagrand, Redridge Mountains, Silvermoon City (Burning Crusade), Silverpine Forest, Stonetalon Mountains, Stormwind City, Tirisfal Glades, Western Plaguelands, Westfall, Wetlands
description: When you have two rabbits, you'll often soon have three.

name: Rapana Whelk
description: Has been spotted fighting other whelks for prime food sources.

name: Frostfur Rat
description: Annoying and destructive, they can be coaxed with enough cheese to become a tolerable companion.

name: Tiny Twister
description: Twisters delight in sneaking up on unsuspecting creatures and surprising them with gusts up their nostrils.

name: Arcane Eye
description: Never take your eye off of it.

name: Emperor Crab
description: The emperor crab was named for its regal appearance: the ridges of its shell and its raised claws eerily resembling a crown. One that would pinch your eyes out if you tried to wear it.

name: Kun-Lai Runt
description: Indigenous to the peaks of Kun-Lai Summit, this rare yeti is much more dangerous than it looks.

name: Squirky
description: During a special time of year, a secretive clan of murlocs often sends young tadpoles out to explore, adventure, and begin their tale.

name: Crazy Carrot
description: Left to their own devices, carrots will simply lose their minds.

name: Aqir Scuttler
description: These Aqir Scuttlers are persistent and among the most numerous of the many Aqir creatures.

name: Aqir Wingreaver
description: The winged aqir are very fast and agile, and their wings provide a nice breeze on a warm afternoon.

name: Venom Elemental
description: As potent as he is diminutive.

name: Corrosive Writhling
description: They're so cute when they're young! You still don't want to touch it...

name: Volatile Venomfang
description: The youngest venomfangs have the deadliest bites.

name: Frosticus Maximus
description: Trying to live up to her ancestry, this little one is ready to rampage. She is going to start with small spiders and work up from there.

name: Silento
source: |cFFFFD200Achievements:|r Showdown Success: Val and Showdown Success: Naigtal|n|cFFFFD200Vendor: |rKifaan|n|cFFFFD200Zones: |rVal or Naigtal|n|cFFFFD200Cost: |r15|Hcurrency:3316|h|TInterface\ICONS\INV_112_RaidTrinkets_VoidPrism.BLP:0|t|h
description: Unlike most Voidwalkers in the Voidstorm, Silento prefers the peace and quiet of silence. Even if that means silencing the more chatty of his kin.

name: Preyhunter's Prismguard
description: A floating heart of magic drives a body made for the finish.

name: Preyhunter's Riftbreaker
description: Each step hums with mana; each punch ends the chase.

name: Pinky
description: Pinky just hatched and is ready for adventure. But naptime may take precedence.

name: Vibrant Venomfang
description: Ula'tek's venom gave rise to new color variants of wind serpents, like this little pink one.

name: Snek'zali
description: Demands scritches and blood sacrifices.

name: Aqir Razorwing
description: The winged aqir are very fast and agile, and their wings provide a nice breeze on a warm afternoon.

name: Bewitching Familiar
description: Don't be put off by this cat's icy demeanor.

name: Archmage's Familiar
description: Knocks potions and reagents off shelves for "research purposes."

name: Catsramas
description: Sometimes a good cat nap is all you need to stave off death.

name: Cat'Thuzad
description: Do not let this cat cross your path.

name: Mewkahen
description: When a cat has been raised among the Tol'vir can you blame themd being a bit aloof?

name: Amewbisath
description: Amewbisath is a menace to the smallest of qiraji.

name: Classic Clockwork Quacker
description: Quack. Beep. Beep. Quack.

name: Aquatic Clockwork Quacker
description: Beep. Beep. Quack. Quack.

name: Pale Hexscale
description: Its bite carries more than venom.

name: Skipper
description: Skipper loves water and magic. Watch out if you get her angry!

name: Slitherfang
description: Rescued from the Altar of Fangs, Slitherfang is a tenacious, fierce, and positively adorable survivor.

name: Ula'took
description: Found during your ordeal in The Venemous Abyss, this little fella sure has a strong bite!

name: Three-Eyed Fish
description: Like Neltharion, this fish went mad listening to whispers of the Old Cods.

name: Ki'clak
description: The Snip Snapper. Also known as the Snip Snacker.

name: Zesty
description: His bite has a zing to it.

name: Poison Dart Frog
description: Lost in an eternal battle of who croaks first.

name: Cauldron Concoction
description: Infused with a raging spirit and a combination of pristine ritual ingredients.

name: Soulcoil Remnant
description: Even a failed ritual can leave something behind.

name: Lil' Mon
description: Big Mon was all alone until he found an injured snakebiter. He nursed the snakebiter back to health and named him Lil' Mon. Big Mon may have been undead, but he wasn't heartless. He loved Lil' Mon and would do anything to protect his only friend.

name: J'imothy
description: Got into a spot of trouble digging through magical garbage in Silvermoon. Luckily, you were there to help him out!

name: Slayer's Faithful Tracker
description: A faithful hound to accompany you through the monster-ridden woods.

name: Inquisitor's Messenger
description: This loyal companion bears the holy words of the inquisitor's across lands touched by darkness.

name: Hex-Cursed Manifestation
description: PH

name: Zyg'ee
description: She sees you when you're sleeping.

name: Bump
description: Small in nature, plenty of strength.

name: Lump
description: Once sat alone in a boggy marsh. Now eager to join on your adventures.

name: Grump
description: Small in nature, mighty in spirit.

name: Frump
description: It's not clear how Frump got her name, but she loves being an enigma.

name: Petite Snow Buddy
description: So much holiday spirit inside an itty-bitty amount of snow, it only makes sense to share it with the world!
